728.title: Contents
728.notes: Agenda lists control problem, practical/feedforward/dual-rate/parameter issues, industrial control and Lyapunov. Footer 2.

729.title: Manipulator rigid-body dynamics
729.notes: M(q) qddot + V(q,qdot)+G(q); inertia coupling, Coriolis/centrifugal, gravity, friction mentioned. Diagram two links l1,m1 and l2,m2, downward m1g,m2g,g, torque arrows tau1,tau2; theta2 marked relative dashed local horizontal, not infer complete DH convention. Footer 3.

730.title: Partitioned computed torque and friction
730.notes: Adds F(q,qdot) friction/non-rigid effects; tau=alpha tauprime+beta with alpha=M and beta=V+G+F. Footer 4.

731.title: Servo law and error dynamics
731.notes: tauprime=qddot_d+Kv Edot+Kp E, E=qd-q. Ideal error Eddot+Kv Edot+Kp E=0; joint scalar form implicitly requires diagonal gains. Diagram gains sum upstream of M(q), compensation added after; sensed q,qdot feed model and error subtraction. Footer 5.

732.title: Practical ideal-model assumptions
732.notes: Continuous-time exact model zero sensing/actuation delay assumptions; compute cost and inaccurate load/wear/friction parameters. Footer 6.

733.title: Sampling and digital implementation
733.notes: Sensors/commands at discrete instants, delay/approximation/performance loss, slow sampling can affect stability; fast sampling only makes continuous approximation more reasonable. No numeric sampling threshold. Footer 7.

734.title: Feedforward nonlinear control diagrams
734.notes: Left exact-model loop uses sensed q,qdot in M,V,G,F; right model inputs are desired acceleration/velocity/position and directly adds torque-domain Kp E+Kv Edot. Output theta has prime-like mark on diagram, velocity theta dot. Feedback retained, model outside fast servo. Footer 8. Desired-state feedforward generally leaves model trajectory mismatch residual, requiring qualification of next-page homogeneous equation.

735.title: Feedforward error equation and configuration dependence
735.notes: Printed Eddot+M(q)^−1 Kv Edot+M(q)^−1 Kp E=0. Faster separate/offline model for known trajectory; not completely decoupled; poles depend on configuration. Scope poles as frozen-configuration and homogeneous equation as additional cancellation/constant-model assumption, not exact desired-state feedforward generally. Footer 9.

736.title: Dual-rate computation split
736.notes: Slow nonlinear dynamic model background process, fast servo/error feedback. No fixed frequency/ratio specified. Footer 10.

737.title: Dual-rate block diagram
737.notes: Configuration-space diagram: desired acceleration+Kp position error+Kv velocity error pass through M(theta); additive B(theta)+C(theta) and G(theta) feed torque sum. Red ellipse encloses B+C and G, not M, arrow to Computed by background Process. Actual theta feeds M,B+C,G via dashed paths; actual theta dot feeds B+C. B/C individually undefined here; do not invent decomposition formula or assume all model blocks highlighted. Footer 11.

738.title: Disturbance error coupling and equilibrium
738.notes: Diagram subtracts tau_d at arm input. Therefore positive M^-1 tau_d on E dynamics is consistent E=desired-actual. SSE Kp^-1 M^-1 tau_d assumes constant disturbance, equilibrium, invertibility. Non-diagonal inertia permits cross-joint effects; not necessarily every joint every configuration. Footer 12.

739.title: Estimated versus actual dynamic model
739.notes: Hat M,V,G,F versus true values; controller alpha=hatM,beta=hatV+hatG+hatF. Exact displayed residual hatM^-1[(M-hatM)qddot+(V-hatV)+(G-hatG)+(F-hatF)] is algebraically consistent; contains actual acceleration, not desired. Perfect-model residual zero; generic mismatch loses decoupling, not universal failure. Footer 13.

740.title: Industrial joint-control rationale
740.notes: Source claims many/most industrial arms use simple robust almost independent joints, compute/model knowledge/good-enough cost-benefit. Photo illustrative no model-dependent engineering data. Treat prevalence as course statement, not current market survey. Footer 14.

741.title: Individual-joint PID
741.notes: Alpha=I,beta=0; displayed tauprime=qddot_d+Kv Edot+Kp E+Ki integralE, qddot_d often set0 because unavailable. Diagonal gains/no model compensation. Diagram parallel P,D,I branches plus encoder negative feedback. Dimensional omission: alpha=I maps torque command but unit coefficient desired angular acceleration cannot add to SI torque unless inertia/normalization supplied. Scope numeric tasks qddot_d=0 and torque-domain gains. Footer 15.

742.title: Joint-control limits and gravity compensation
742.notes: No exact decoupling; interactions and imperfect disturbance rejection, posture-varying damping so average gains. Adds hatG to PID/desired acceleration law. Gravity creates SSE blanket claim requires qualification: ideal stable unsaturated integral action can supply constant gravity with zero final E; PD has finite E. Same acceleration-to-torque unit omission as741. Footer 16.

743.title: Lyapunov motivation and performance distinction
743.notes: Energy-like positive function decreases along trajectories; stability without solving ODE. Stable not necessarily fast/good tracking. Wording will settle is too broad for mere Lyapunov stability; need asymptotic/invariance argument. Footer 17.

744.title: Linear mass-spring-damper energy
744.notes: m xddot+b xdot+kx=0; v=1/2 m xdot²+1/2 kx²; derivative m xdot xddot+kx xdot=−b xdot²≤0. Rest kx=0 implies x=0 if k≠0. Require m,k>0 for positive definite energy and b>0 for dissipation. Derivative semidefinite in (x,xdot); asymptotic conclusion needs only invariant zero-derivative point, or positive-coefficient characteristic roots. Footer 18.

745.title: Direct method conditions and domain
745.notes: Xdot=f(X), C1 positive-definite v with v(0)=0; vdot≤0 stability and <0 away from equilibrium asymptotic stability. Omitted equilibrium/regularity/local-domain qualification and compact-sublevel/properness for global boundedness. Cannot infer globally bounded state from arbitrary positive decreasing function alone. Footer 19.

746.title: Nonlinear spring-damper candidate
746.notes: xddot+b(xdot)+k(x)=0 normalized mass. vdotnotation here v energy; nonlinear b and k functions NOT constant coefficients times arguments. Sign conditions xdot*b(xdot)>0 and x*k(x)>0 away0. Candidate v=.5 xdot²+integral0^x k(lambda)dlambda; negative x integral remains positive. Need b(0)=k(0)=0 and continuity/local-Lipschitz for usual equilibrium/invariance. Footer20.

747.title: Nonlinear derivative and invariant rest set
747.notes: Derivative xdot[xddot+k(x)]=−xdot*b(xdot)≤0; zero when xdot0 need not imply x0 at instant. Right text erroneously For all trajectories xdot=0 and switches nonlinear k(x) to −kx; xddot=−kx also has nonzero moving solutions. Correct argument restrict trajectories remaining in zero-derivative set, then xdot identically0→xddot0 and b0=0→k(x)=0→x0. Footer21.
